# HandleQueryValue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

HandleQuery() that stores the value in `out`.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
Err HandleQueryValue(Handle h, QueryWhat what, uint32_t *out);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to inspect. |
| `what` | in | Property to read. |
| `out` | out | Receives the value on success; may be NULL. |

## Returns

As HandleQueryAt().
